name: crew-scribes
description: Three AI scribes that help a family turn an elder's recorded stories into lessons for Undying Tongues. They read the family's transcripts (never the audio) and propose meanings, word breakdowns (root + suffixes) and accepted spellings. Every proposal is validated by the same rules the app's property tests check, written to a separate suggestions file, and applied only when a person accepts it in the app.
author: LudwigAngel
highlights: Glossator, Morphologist and Orthographer work in parallel on one family archive
Reads transcripts only: the elder's voice never reaches a model
Every proposal is validated before it is saved: no overwriting family text, ejective apostrophes kept, word breakdowns must rebuild the word
Writes only a sibling suggestions file; the family accepts or rejects each card in the app
useCases: After a grandmother records a story and the family transcribes it, ask the crew to run the scribes on the exported archive, then accept the meanings you agree with in the app
When a child keeps getting 'orqo' marked wrong, let scribe-orthographer propose 'urqu' as an accepted spelling and approve it
When a story is full of long words, run scribe-morphologist to see each one split into root and suffixes before teaching it
configuration: Needs Node.js 18+ on PATH and Python 3 for the bundled undying-archive MCP server. Export the archive from the Undying Tongues app (Story harvest -> Export family archive) and give the crew its absolute path.
